cards.a: North Carolina - Street signs with letters (SR) and arrows
cards.note: North Carolina commonly uses a style of street signs showing street numbers (SR) and arrows in addition to the street name. They tend to appear at intersections with other SR roads, but can also be installed elsewhere. If the arrow is missing, I would still trust this meta. The so called Secondary Road system is still unique to this state. Do not confuse it with a similar Pennsylvania meta, tho (in Pennsylvania, SR stands for State Route). Road numbers following SR are sometimes marked on the map with a rectangular number tag and can help with pinpointing.
